Last night I took about of xanax I dont think it did very much to me except put me to sleep but the next morning I woke up and popped another one so I went on with my day and that morning somone asked me if I would like to buy some addorall so I did I took them with great anticipation because I had neigher done xanax or addorall before and I had no clue what kind of trip to expect so I was sitting down in my chair which was unuasally soft I guess because of the xanax than I also found my self in love with everyone and everything it was very much like most people describe extacy as I got very in touch with my emotions and for moments I found my self crying in class, not because I was sad but because I was so happy, It was by far the greatest experience I have ever had the best part was it lasted for 6 hours I was extremely grateful and just was in love with everyone.
